response.description: A family-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures a trained GRU4Rec model through the host ModelView interface and produces an interpretation prompt grounded in measured metrics and their definitions.
response.motivation: Support model improvement using reproducible diagnostics while preserving the GRU4Rec backbone, benchmark protocol, dataset routing, and single-model constraint.
response.implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). The loader supplies (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), and predict_score(features, items). For left-padded histories, read the final nonpadding position rather than count−1. Use only observed histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; treat unavailable review data and simulator traits as unobserved. Route each category to exactly one independently trained checkpoint. Select improvements by macro validation HR@10 across all four categories. The supplied description contains no measured results or complete probe definitions.
response.pseudocode:
Initialize DiagnosisProbe(view, device).
Set view.model to evaluation mode and disable gradients.
For each loader batch:
  Extract sequence, positive, and negative tensors.
  Obtain family-compatible features with view.log2feats(sequence).
  Exclude padding from applicable measurements.
  Score items through view.predict_score(features, items).
  Accumulate explicitly defined diagnostic measurements.
Return {metrics, metric_definitions}.
Construct diagnosis_interpreter_prompt from those measurements and definitions, identifying missing evidence and avoiding unsupported causal claims.

originality.positive: Connects family-specific sequential-model diagnostics to an automated improvement workflow.
originality.negative: Primarily an interface and evaluation specification; it introduces no explicit new diagnostic algorithm. Score uses a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Could support targeted GRU4Rec improvements and comparable diagnosis across categories.
future_potential.negative: Its usefulness depends on defining reliable probes and demonstrating that their findings predict validation improvements. Score uses a 1–10 scale.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interfaces and batch format provide a clear implementation boundary.
code_difficulty.negative: Correct padding handling, metric aggregation, architecture compatibility, and checkpoint–predictor consistency require care. Score uses a 1–10 scale, where higher means harder.
